working_definition: Author type 'lamina neuron' (L3_65, lamina class) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 larval optic lobe atlas: differentiating lamina neurons, the lamina monopolar neurons L1-L5 labelled in Fig 1c.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will develop into an adult lamina monopolar neuron.

justification: Per curator context the lamina neurons are L1-L5 lamina monopolar neurons (grouped, unresolved). FBbt has immature L1-L5 terms (FBbt:00053356-00053360) whose common parent is immature lamina monopolar neuron; broad because the type spans L1-L5.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will develop into an adult lamina monopolar neuron L1.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Single member; the type groups L1-L5 (also immature L2 FBbt:00053357, L3 FBbt:00053358, L4 FBbt:00053359, L5 FBbt:00053360).

other_candidates.fbbt_term: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will have its synapses restricted to the optic lobe in the adult.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific than immature lamina monopolar neuron.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053355 'immature lamina monopolar neuron' (broad match).
